axes.read: Crooked-inning volatility: mistake chaos, run clustering, one-bad-inning, bullpen mistakes, carry, and visibility.

axes.label: Freeze
axes.read: Dead-offense risk: quiet first five, scoreless first three, dead traffic, and traffic without conversion.

axes.label: Air
axes.read: Contact carry and outfield-event risk: weather carry, sun visibility, hard air contact, and extra-base tail.

axes.label: Bridge
axes.read: Late-inning volatility: bullpen flip, reliever command risk, and middle-relief mistake exposure.

axes.label: Flow
axes.read: Phase agreement: whether full game, first five, late, and bridge point in the same direction.

scoringPolicy.rp2: RP2 is a team-side bullpen path projection. Use for late scoring risk, bridge stress, and bullpen-path warnings, not exact first reliever identity.
scoringPolicy.sp1: SP1 is the starter or bulk-primary pitcher-collapse profile. It blends canonical L/R splits, day/night, home/away, pitch fit, repeat opponent, recent form, and ENV1 carry as shadow deltas until promoted by backtest.
